name: Klak's Infernal Artifact
description: Defeat Klak and destroy the infernal artifact.

specialRules.description: Whenever you cancel an Encounter card by spending XP, the active Hero takes 1 damage.
Whenever you explore a new white-arrow tile, you may discard a Treasure card to gain a new power.

introText: Chaos magic storms now threaten Barovia, and the Heroes must stop Klak’s experiment.
victoryText: Klak is defeated and the infernal artifact is destroyed! The magic storm dissipates, saving Barovia.
defeatText: Klak has completed his dark ritual. The infernal artifact's energy consumes you, and all of Barovia falls to his chaos magic.
